integrity: Proof uses cyclic trace identities and Schatten Holder. Computations supplement, not replace, the proof.
scientific_limitations: The exact identity is proven only at exponent four. Historical equivalent trace identities are a residual novelty risk; independent verification and priority check not performed. Supplementary diagnostics are finite and do not prove infinite-dimensional quantifiers.
title: A sharp commutator remainder in the quartic complementary McCarthy inequality
